text:
tia raymond: Quick flag from morning metrics 6a6 ~3.8% of MQLs from the webinar form showed up as \"owner: null\" in HubSpot between 07:20-07:40 UTC. Salesops saw a bunch of unclaimed leads.

noah li: Ack. Any recent workflow or property changes? I pushed a mapping for utm_source last week.

carmen gomez: I pulled the audit log 4dd and there are 7 workflow failures tied to the \"enrich-profile\" webhook returning 504. Those stuck the lead in pending_enrich state.

sam patel: That service started returning 504s after we flipped the new retry middleware. It delays responses by ~12s on some routes. Our RR logic waits for enrich completion before assignment for routes marked \"require_enrichment\".

tia raymond: We can't keep blocking assignment for that long. SLA to first owner should be <= 45s for event-driven leads. Can we change the behavior so enrichment is async and assignment is immediate, with a secondary enrichment job?

noah li: I like that. Proposed minimal change: set hubspot.routing.require_enrichment=false for campaign:webinar-2026 for 48 hours, and create a backfill job for any pending_enrich leads.

carmen gomez: Backfill SQL to find affected rows: 
```sql
SELECT id, created_at FROM leads WHERE source='webinar-2026' AND owner IS NULL AND status='pending_enrich';
```
I can run it with a 1k batch limit.

sam patel: I'll add a temporary guard in routing service: if enrich_latency > 8s then assign fallback_owner=salesops_pool and mark enrichment_async=true. Patch snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  route:webinar-2026:
    require_enrichment: false
    fallback_owner: salesops_pool
    enrich_async: true
```

tia raymond: Can we also add an alert to page on-call if unassigned_rate > 1% for 10m? Marketing ops shouldn't be the first detector.

devops-bot: Alert rule created by sam patel - \"marketing.unassigned_rate.webinar-2026\" threshold=1% duration=10m.

noah li: Timeline? If sam can deploy the guard now we can monitor and run backfill tomorrow morning.

sam patel: Deploying patch in ~30m to staging, will do prod after a quick smoke. Will post logs here.

carmen gomez: Running the SQL to snapshot affected leads and exported to S3: s3://redwood-ops/exports/webinar-2026-unassigned-2026-03-21.csv

tia raymond: Thanks all. Once live I'll update the campaign doc and notify SDR queue owners. Post-deploy check: confirm HubSpot owner field updated within 60s for new leads.

noah li: Noted. Also will follow up with the eng-ml team to see if enrichment can be trimmed (drop a redundant external API call). Might shave 200ms per request.

sam patel: Patch went to prod - short smoke looked good, no increase in errors. Monitoring dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/lead-routing/webinar-2026

carmen gomez: Backfill job queued (job id jb_78912). Will run at 02:00 UTC to avoid SDR noise.

tia raymond: Perfect. Closing the loop here 44d will check metrics tomorrow AM and reopen if we see regressions.
